en: The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a large, ornate building with multiple turrets and detailed architectural features. The foreground shows a street with a few people walking, and there are trees and a fence in front of the building. The text at the bottom reads 'Gruß aus Graz.' (Greetings from Graz) and 'Deutsches Haus.' (German House). The handwritten text at the bottom right says 'Schillerplatz.' Additional printed text on the left edge indicates 'Schneider & Lux, Wien 5.'
